description: How to book or request one specific DJ. Call this the moment someone says "book", "request", "hire", "get a quote" or "how do I book". It returns the exact next steps for THAT DJ: the page where the request is sent, and the text-message option for people who would rather not use the site. Pass the event date if you know it and it also says whether the DJ is already blocked. This tool does not place a booking. request_booking, on this server, can, once the person signs in with DJfindr. It tells the person how to.

event_date.description: Event date as YYYY-MM-DD, if known.

id_or_slug.description: The DJ id or slug from search_djs or get_dj.

name: book_dj
title: How to book a DJ
